title: Hey all! New to this sub
content: I feel kind of strange that I just found it after having a dream of being in a mall that went downward and became very creepy but I just wanted to share my experience. So the earliest thing I can remember is I was walking through a mall I’ve never been to by myself when I saw a girl I vaguely used to know and hangout out with, with her friends. Next thing I remember she catches up with me and we reconnect somewhat briefly and then start walking together with her friend I don’t recognize. Next thing I remember we start going to the inner workings of the mall and start exploring the basement area of it when “ her friend” says “ watch this” and stomps her foot to on the floor to reveal a secret passage way below the basement. We descend down into it and are greeted with a network of ikea like bedrooms that all meet together door after door. Next thing I remember I start chasing “her friend” ( I say that in quotes because I don’t recognize her at all or have ever met) when she suddenly disappears when I open the next door of these bizarre bedrooms. When I saw that she was gone I realized something was very wrong and began to race back towards the path of the maze I came in from to find the entrance. During that I realized something was chasing me trying to drag me back into the maze of bedrooms. I eventually found my way to an escalator and started to work my way back up. When I turned around I couldn’t see what was chasing me but I heard the voice of it saying “Why?.. Why??” After I rose up the escalator I woke up. What do you all think? I’m genuinely flabbergasted by this dream and have never had anything like it in my life. Would love to get some feedback from you. Thank you for your time.
